<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9FAFA"/>
  
  <!-- iOS status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <text x="22" y="21" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="324" y1="18" x2="329" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="16" x2="337" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="14" x2="345" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="17" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="297" y1="20" x2="303" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="353" y="11" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="356" y="14" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="376" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- hero -->
  <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="290" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="75" r="62" fill="#ADD993" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="246" r="70" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.28"/>
  <text x="24" y="78" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">mint</text>
  <text x="24" y="109" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#267347">Good food, good people.</text>
  <text x="24" y="130" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#267347">Welcome back to your table.</text>
  
  <!-- food illustration -->
  <ellipse cx="199" cy="222" rx="122" ry="39" fill="#063336" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="189" r="92" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="189" r="77" fill="#F0F2F3"/>
  <ellipse cx="166" cy="176" rx="29" ry="18" fill="#5DB329" transform="rotate(-20 166 176)"/>
  <ellipse cx="210" cy="160" rx="26" ry="15" fill="#40BF76" transform="rotate(25 210 160)"/>
  <ellipse cx="230" cy="198" rx="31" ry="19" fill="#5DB075" transform="rotate(-15 230 198)"/>
  <circle cx="150" cy="207" r="17" fill="#FFAE1B"/>
  <circle cx="185" cy="205" r="14" fill="#E7574C"/>
  <circle cx="207" cy="181" r="12" fill="#FBBD00"/>
  <circle cx="245" cy="170" r="9" fill="#E7574C"/>
  <ellipse cx="181" cy="153" rx="13" ry="7" fill="#8CD9AD" transform="rotate(-45 181 153)"/>
  <line x1="195" y1="189" x2="260" y2="142" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="264" cy="138" r="7" fill="#4B9460"/>
  <text x="195" y="286" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#267347">Discover meals made with care</text>

  <!-- login panel shadow and panel -->
  <rect x="15" y="275" width="360" height="493" rx="20" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
  <rect x="15" y="270" width="360" height="493" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="38" y="311" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Welcome back</text>
  <text x="38" y="337" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Sign in to continue your food journey</text>

  <!-- email field -->
  <text x="38" y="367" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Email adress</text>
  <rect x="38" y="376" width="314" height="54" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="402" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="52,397 59,403 66,397" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="79" y="407" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">you@example.com</text>

  <!-- password field -->
  <text x="38" y="456" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Password</text>
  <rect x="38" y="465" width="314" height="54" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="52" y="486" width="14" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="55,486 55,482 63,482 63,486" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="323" cy="492" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="318" y1="497" x2="328" y2="487" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="79" y="497" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Enter your password</text>

  <!-- remember / forgot -->
  <rect x="38" y="541" width="16" height="16" rx="4" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <polyline points="42,549 46,553 52,546" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <text x="62" y="554" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Remember me</text>
  <text x="252" y="554" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">Forgot password?</text>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="38" y="576" width="314" height="56" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="611" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="38" y1="653" x2="169" y2="653" stroke="#E1E4E8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="658" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">or continue with</text>
  <line x1="221" y1="653" x2="352" y2="653" stroke="#E1E4E8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- secondary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="38" y="674" width="314" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="166" cy="698" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="704" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Continue with Google</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="747" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">New to mint?</text>
  <text x="259" y="747" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Create an account</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="790" width="390" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="790" x2="390" y2="790" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,806 48,799 57,806 57,817 51,817 51,810 45,810 45,817 39,817" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="48" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="126" cy="807" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="131" y1="812" x2="137" y2="818" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="126" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="193" y="801" width="14" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="197" y1="798" x2="203" y2="798" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="197" y1="805" x2="203" y2="805" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="197" y1="809" x2="203" y2="809" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="200" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Orders</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="272" cy="804" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="272" cy="815" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="272" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="333" y="803" width="14" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="337,815 337,819 342,815" fill="#97A2B0"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="809" r="1" fill="#97A2B0"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="809" r="1" fill="#97A2B0"/>
    <text x="340" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Help</text>
  </g>
</svg>
